cell_type.evidence: Using pluripotent stem cells, we identify that several patterning signals –including WNT, BMP and FGF– converge into the modulation of DNA replication stress and damage during S-phase, which in turn controls chromosome segregation fidelity in mitosis.

developmental_stage.evidence: Human development relies on the correct replication, maintenance and segregation of our genetic blueprints.

material_type.evidence: hiPSCs were seeded in 10 cm dishes in Essential 8 media and treated with control (untreated), DKK1 conditional medium (1:3), Noggin (200ng/ml) or FGF2 (40ng/mL) (See Supplementary Data 1 on the article) for 3 hours before harvesting.
